827.body:
One of 50th Anniversary's top prizes was claimed last week. A player in Ohio won $15 million. The game started with three top prizes and now has one top prize. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

50th Anniversary's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

If you play "50th Anniversary" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
827.headline: Fewer $15 million prizes left

847.body:
The $500,000 top prize on "Bingo 50X" is no longer available because all four have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $100,000. Use that amount when you decide.

If "Bingo 50X" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
